India’s squad for IDFC First Bank ODI series against South Africa announced
India’s squad for IDFC First Bank ODI series against South Africa announced
The Senior Men’s Selection Committee has picked India’s squad for the upcoming IDFC First Bank three-match ODI series against South Africa.

: Rohit Sharma, Yashasvi Jaiswal, Virat Kohli, Tilak Varma, KL Rahul (C) (wk), Rishabh Pant (wk), Washington Sundar, Ravindra Jadeja, Kuldeep Yadav, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Harshit Rana, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Prasidh Krishna, Arshdeep Singh, Dhruv Jurel
South Africa’s Tour of India, 2025 (ODI Series)
